Verify before touching the live column: every row must have customer_id_new equal to customer_id. Fails the plan (nothing swapped yet, app unaffected) if any row differs.

Collect planner statistics for the new column (they stay with it through the rename), so the /customer query keeps its current plan.

Swap in one short transaction, retried with a 300ms lock_timeout: SET NOT NULL on customer_id_new (no scan, proven by the validated check), drop the check and the trigger, drop the old integer column (metadata-only, no rewrite), rename customer_id_new to customer_id. The app's SQL is unchanged and uses the bigint column from its next query.
Drop the now unused trigger function and check the result: orders.customer_id is bigint NOT NULL.
